taxonomies.name: Product Dimensions
taxonomies.definition: Physical measurements and sizing specifications of arts and crafts products, e.g. container volume, item proportions for age groups

taxonomies.name: Color Characteristics
taxonomies.definition: Visual color properties including variety, intensity, and appearance of arts and crafts materials, e.g. color selection range, brightness levels

taxonomies.name: Container Design
taxonomies.definition: Physical structure and functionality of product packaging and storage containers, e.g. box construction, lid mechanisms, bulk packaging formats

taxonomies.name: Package Condition
taxonomies.definition: Physical state and integrity of packaging upon receipt, e.g. structural damage, seal tampering, durability failures

taxonomies.name: Material Composition
taxonomies.definition: Chemical and ingredient properties of arts and crafts materials, e.g. allergen content, toxicity levels

taxonomies.name: Writing Point Performance
taxonomies.definition: Physical condition and functionality of pencil, marker, or crayon tips, e.g. durability, sharpness retention, breakage resistance

taxonomies.name: Surface Feel
taxonomies.definition: Tactile properties and consistency of arts and crafts materials, e.g. smoothness, softness, texture quality

taxonomies.name: Structural Integrity
taxonomies.definition: Physical form and straightness of rigid arts and crafts items, e.g. pencil alignment, shape distortion

taxonomies.name: Ergonomic Features
taxonomies.definition: Physical design elements that affect handling and user comfort, e.g. grip surfaces, holding mechanisms

taxonomies.name: Product Longevity
taxonomies.definition: How long arts and crafts products maintain their usability and structural integrity over time, e.g. markers drying out, pencils lasting through multiple projects

taxonomies.name: Structural Integrity During Use
taxonomies.definition: How well products withstand normal handling and usage without breaking or damage, e.g. pencil leads breaking during sharpening, crayons snapping under pressure

taxonomies.name: Color Output Quality
taxonomies.definition: The visual characteristics and application smoothness of colors produced by arts and crafts materials, e.g. pigment intensity, color blending capability, smoothness of application

taxonomies.name: Point Maintenance
taxonomies.definition: How well drawing and coloring tools maintain their tip sharpness and precision during use, e.g. pencil leads staying sharp after sharpening, markers maintaining fine tips

taxonomies.name: Product Restoration
taxonomies.definition: The ability to restore dried or depleted arts and crafts materials to working condition, e.g. reactivating watercolors with water, reconstituting dried paints
